verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents an MCP server and connections to agent tools like Cursor, Claude Code and Codex CLI. It also positions itself as one place where work from people and agents is tracked, so it can act as a shared context hub that multiple tools or agents read from and write to. However, nothing describes an explicit handoff mechanism or guarantees that context is preserved when work moves between agents. Missing for 10: a documented agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff feature, evidence that full context (history, specs, state) carries over intact, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information
